description: Iterative Testing with browser-use - Complete 10 rounds of end-to-end testing: upload books, read, concept graph, extract, fix issues found

userStories.title: Round 1: Upload and Parse Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to use browser-use to upload sample books and test the upload/parse flow so that I can identify issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Click Parse button and verify extraction begins
Document any issues found in tasks/reports/round1-report.md
Take screenshots and save to tasks/screenshots/round1/

userStories.title: Round 2: Extract and Core Concepts Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to verify the Extract concepts functionality so that I can identify issues with the extraction flow.
acceptanceCriteria: After parsing completes, click Extract button
Click Core Concepts button and verify modal works
userStories.notes: Fixed: Increased semaphore count from 1 to 4 and reduced LLM timeout from 120s to 60s to allow parallel extraction. Issue was that sequential processing with long timeouts caused extraction to appear stuck.

userStories.title: Round 3: EPUB Upload and Reading Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to upload and read an EPUB book so that I can identify EPUB-specific issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Click on EPUB book to open reader
userStories.notes: All acceptance criteria passed. Minor P3 issue: page number shows 'Unknown' for EPUB.

userStories.title: Round 4: PDF Reading and Navigation Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to verify PDF reading functionality so that I can identify PDF display issues.

userStories.title: Round 5: Concept Graph Interaction Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to verify concept graph interactions so that I can identify graph-related issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Test node click to show details

userStories.title: Round 6: Multiple Book Upload Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to upload multiple books so that I can identify issues with book management.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify all books appear in library

userStories.title: Round 7: UI/UX and Language Toggle Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to verify UI elements and language toggle so that I can identify UI/UX issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify all text updates correctly on language switch

userStories.title: Round 8: Error Handling and Edge Cases
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to test error handling so that I can identify how the app handles edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Test clicking Parse on already parsed book
Verify app recovers gracefully from errors

userStories.title: Round 9: Regression and Integration Testing
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to verify previously found issues are fixed so that I can ensure no regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify fixes from earlier rounds still work
Test full workflow: upload -> parse -> extract -> view graph
Test book switching preserves state correctly

userStories.title: Round 10: Final Verification and Summary
userStories.description: As a tester, I want to complete the final round of testing so that I can verify the product is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm if termination criteria met (3 consecutive rounds no new issues)
